rubrics.intent_basis: R1/R2 registration and late relocation classification.
rubrics.baseline_defect: Processing and late relocation rejection independently enumerate supported section/architecture combinations.
rubrics.criterion: Use a coherent special-section membership and architecture policy across regeneration and late relocation classification.
rubrics.acceptance: Preserve all 23 existing kinds and architecture masks. Late rejection remains conditional on actual need_klp_reloc, !KLP_ARCH and non-vmlinux; membership does not make every special section emit architecture metadata. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Copying the existing independently maintained policy into renamed local branches or sharing only token spelling while retaining independent semantic interpretations is insufficient.
